Field.Name: SymbolIndex
Field.Description: UTP-MD proprietary identification of the instrument

Field.Name: SourceSeqNum
Field.Description: This field specifies the sequence number assigned by the source system to this message

Field.Name: SourceTime
Field.Description: This field specifies the message generation time

Field.Name: SystemID
Field.Description: The ID of the originating Exchange/System of the message

Field.Name: SourceTimeMicroSecs
Field.Description: Number of micro seconds to be combined with SourceTime

Field.Name: Filler
Field.Description: For future use

Field.Name: StartDateHalting
Field.Description: Date when suspension of trading started for an instrument

Field.Name: StartTimeHalting
Field.Description: Time when suspension of trading started for an instrument

Field.Name: ProgOpeningTime
Field.Description: Instrument opening (unhalting) time that has been programmed by the Market Operation Team

Field.Name: OrderEntryRejection
Field.Description: Indicates whether order entry is allowed or forbidden

Field.Name: InstrumentState
Field.Description: Indicates the state of the instrument

Field.Name: InstrumentTradingStatus
Field.Description: Not used

Field.Name: HaltReason
Field.Description: Indicates the origin of halting for an instrument

Field.Name: ActionAffectingState
Field.Description: Code indicating the event that caused a change in the instrument state

Field.Name: InstrumentStateTCS
Field.Description: Not used

Field.Name: PeriodSide
Field.Description: Indicates the side for an instrument beginning or ending a Bid only or Offer only situation

Field.Name: Filler
Field.Description: For future use

Message.Name: Indicative Matching Price Message
Message.Description: The Indicative matching price message indicates an instrument's theoretical opening price (also known as an indicative opening price):  An IMP-message is sent if the indicative matching price or – volume varies

Field.Name: SymbolIndex
Field.Description: UTP-MD proprietary identification of the instrument

Field.Name: SourceSeqNum
Field.Description: This field specifies the sequence number assigned by the source system to this message

Field.Name: SourceTime
Field.Description: This field specifies the message generation time

Field.Name: IMPrice
Field.Description: Indicative Matching Price: Price at which transaction on a security would occur if Opening occurred at this moment (To be calculated with the PriceScaleCode)

Field.Name: Variation
Field.Description: Percentage variation of the last IMP against the previous day's reference price for the stock concerned, ie the last known (signed) price can be the last adjusted closing price or the last price indication (valuation trade).(To be calculated with the VariationScaleCode)

Field.Name: SystemID
Field.Description: The ID of the originating Exchange/System of the message

Field.Name: SourceTimeMicroSecs
Field.Description: Number of micro seconds

Field.Name: PriceScaleCode
Field.Description: To be combined with IMPrice

Field.Name: VariationScaleCode
Field.Description: To be combined with Variation

Field.Name: IMVolume
Field.Description: Indicative Matching Volume: Volume that would be exchanged if Auction occurred at this moment

Message.Name: Generic Wse Message
Message.Description: This message is a free format message with a container of 250 bytes

Field.Name: SourceSeqNum
Field.Description: This field specifies the sequence number assigned by the source system to this message

Field.Name: SourceTime
Field.Description: This field specifies the message generation time

Field.Name: SystemID
Field.Description: The ID of the originating Exchange/System of the message

Field.Name: SourceTimeMicroSecs
Field.Description: Number of micro seconds

Field.Name: SourceData
Field.Description: Source of Data: '1' - UTP Cash '2' - UTP Derivatives '3' - Indexator '4' -BondSpot '5' – other 'space' - not applicable
